As Merck & Co (MRK) Stock Price Declined, Naples Global Advisors Has Raised Holding by $330,232; Vident Investment Advisory Has Raised Its Gilead Sciences (GILD) Holding by $1.41 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Vident Investment Advisory Llc increased its stake in Gilead Sciences Inc (GILD) by 40.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vident Investment Advisory Llc bought 19,833 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.93% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 68,800 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.93 million, up from 48,967 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vident Investment Advisory Llc who had been investing in Gilead Sciences Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $87.94B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.57% or $0.385 during the last trading session, reaching $67.635. About 4.45M shares traded. Gilead Sciences, Inc. (NASDAQ:GILD) has risen 9.79% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.76% the S&P500.
Naples Global Advisors Llc increased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 14.58% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Naples Global Advisors Llc bought 5,897 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 46,350 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.61 million, up from 40,453 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Naples Global Advisors Llc who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $157.25 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.17% or $0.69 during the last trading session, reaching $58.45. About 6.07 million shares traded. Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) has declined 14.94% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.49% the S&P500.
